evidence.title: 九洲清晏 west road, 1831
evidence.summary: 慎德堂 was added on the west road in 1831, with 乐安和 and 怡情书史 removed. 怡情书史 is therefore a state of before 1831, not of 1860.

photos.title: The Qianlong Emperor at Leisure (scroll formerly pasted inside a garden building)
photos.creator: 张廷彦 Zhang Tingyan (1735-94) (S262)
photos.archive: The Palace Museum, Beijing (image credit in S262)
photos.why: S262 says it faithfully depicts the western part of 九洲清晏 and that the emperor sits in the eastern secondary bay of 怡情书史 (Study of Delight in Confucian Canons and Histories), where the scroll itself hung.

reconstructions.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: west road of 九洲清晏 after 1828
reconstructions.why: Sequence of works on Yangshi Lei plans: after 1828 清晖阁 became 湛静斋 with 穿堂殿 and 后殿; 1831 怡情书史 and its fish pond gave way to 慎德堂; 1836 the three axis halls were rebuilt and 同道堂 added; 1846 the four courts of 洞天深处 became two. This fits the labels 前殿, ?顺堂, 后殿 on S01 as the former 湛静斋 group.
reconstructions.caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
